name: ma-pairing-e2e
description: Recording-first e2e harness for Music Assistant: specs double as last-mile integration tests and produce screen recordings of user workflows.

scripts.record: RECORD=1 NODE_OPTIONS='--import tsx' playwright test && node scripts/collect-recordings.mjs
scripts.clean: docker ps -aq --filter label=ma-pairing-e2e=1 | xargs -I{} docker rm -f {}
